summary: Almonty Industries filed a Form 6-K on June 1, 2026, attaching a press release that reminds shareholders to vote ahead of the annual general meeting scheduled for June 9, 2026. The press release recaps recent milestones such as the Sangdong mine ramp-up, a $90M IPO, a $129M follow-on offering, and the acquisition of the Gentung project. It urges votes FOR re-election of director nominees as outlined in the management information circular. There is no bid, activist event, restructuring, tender offer, or other special-situation transaction described; the filing is a routine AGM reminder.
